Home.metaTitle: Coğrafya Platformu — Geography of Türkiye and the World
Home.metaDescription: Free, sourced geography content for the 81 provinces of Türkiye, the countries of the world and landforms. Maps, topic guides and more.
Home.heading: Explore Türkiye and the world through geography
Home.lede: Free geography pages — province, country and landform details, with curriculum-aligned topic guides.
Home.provincesBody: The location, climate and landforms of all 81 provinces — in sourced, structured content.

About.metaDescription: Coğrafya Platformu is an education project that presents the geography of Türkiye and the world through free, sourced and accessible content.
About.heading: About
About.body1: Coğrafya Platformu is an education project that aims to make geography free and accessible to everyone. Content is grounded in authoritative sources and passes an independent verification step before publication.
About.body2: The platform is under development. This page is a demonstration of the multilingual architecture and SEO foundations; content will deepen as coverage expands.

Provinces.heading: Provinces of Türkiye
